items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Paul Gayton is the one that changed the name from You Don't Love Me to True. ... Paul Gayton is the one that put it on.

ctx.x: Yeah. Fine. He said to tell you that he thinks that Cottrell and a couple other guys, a trio recorded a tune that you and Cottrell wrote. And one of the names was True.

Do you remember that? Do you have another name? That was the theme song. The actual title of the song is You Don't Love Me. Now Paul Gayton is the one that changed the name from You Don't Love Me to True.
